parameter_matrix.note: Op-amps (internally compensated for linear feedback) and comparators (uncompensated open-loop switching) are NOT drop-in interchangeable.
Single SOT-23-5 op-amps vary in pin ordering across vendors; verify Pin 1–5.
A part wins only if its recommended Vs range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Exceeding Vs,abs causes immediate gate-oxide or junction breakdown.
Closed-loop -3 dB bandwidth scales as f_-3dB = GBWP / Acl.
Controls large-signal full-power bandwidth SR / (2π·Vpeak) or comparator switching speed.
Lower Vos minimizes DC error in current-shunt and sensor bridge amplifiers.
CMOS/JFET pA-class inputs avoid offset voltage drops across high-impedance (>100 kΩ) sensors.
Multiply by channel count for total IC standby current draw.
RRIO prevents clipping on low-voltage 3.3 V single-supply ADC buffers.
Winner requires superiority on both CMRR (higher) and input voltage noise (lower); mixed tradeoffs stay CONTEXT.
Important when driving heavy resistive loads or high supply rails.

swap_risks: CAUTION BANDWIDTH & PHASE MARGIN: GBWP differs by 12x (LM358DR2G: 1 MHz p.6 vs NE5532DR: 12 MHz p.4); higher-bandwidth replacements can oscillate with capacitive loads or stray feedback capacitance without an isolation resistor.
CAUTION SLEW RATE DIFFERENCE: Slew rate differs by 8.3x (LM358DR2G: 0.6 V/µs p.6 vs NE5532DR: 5 V/µs p.4); check full-power bandwidth SR / (2π·Vpeak).

CAUTION QUIESCENT CURRENT SHIFT: Supply current per channel differs by 8.6x (LM358DR2G: 350 µA/ch p.4 vs NE5532DR: 3000 µA/ch p.4); verify battery budget and total power dissipation across all channels.
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 119% higher on LM358DR2G (LM358DR2G: 212 °C/W p.3 vs NE5532DR: 97 °C/W p.3); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: NE5532DR requires Vs,min >= 10 V (p.3) vs 3 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.
engineering_verdict: LM358DR2G (onsemi, SOIC-8) and NE5532DR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because GBWP differs 12x; slew rate differs 8.3x; quiescent supply current Iq/ch differs 8.6x. Signal-chain deltas: GBWP 1 MHz (p.6) vs 12 MHz (p.4), supply ceiling 30 V (p.4) vs 30 V (p.3), Vos 7 mV (p.4) vs 4 mV (p.4), Ib 4x gap (45000 vs 200000 pA). Primary bench gotchas to watch: LM358DR2G "CRITICAL ESD Trap: Standard onsemi LM358DR2G Is Rated ONLY 250 V HBM / 100 V MM (p.3)!" (p.3) and NE5532DR "Internal Back-to-Back Input Clamp Diodes Conduct Above ~0.6 V Differential Input" (p.3). BOM decision: Choose LM358DR2G when ultra-low supply current (350 µA/ch) is prioritized; choose NE5532DR when closed-loop signal bandwidth requires 12 MHz GBWP. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.2) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
